The shared target FaDu indicates that the drug may exert its effects through a common mechanism, possibly by interfering with metabolic processes critical to cell survival and proliferation in this cell line.

The scores for both paths are similar, suggesting that the drug's interaction with FaDu is robust and consistent across different molecular targets.
